title: AI-assisted Artifact Collaboration Workflow
summary: 已完成 Claire × Primary Artifact Collaboration Workflow 收斂：Human/Conversation artifact → Primary → GitHub publication、GitHub text/source → Primary → Dropbox /AI Output、Primary-owned /AI 工作區 housekeeping，以及 Dropbox PDF reading boundary。Dropbox PDF <=5 MiB 可 full extracted-text fetch；95.15 MB real PDF 驗證 metadata/preview/temp link 可用、full text 受 5 MiB hard limit，且目前無 page-range/partial fetch。Direct binary materialization、autonomous workflow_dispatch、rollback/recovery 均列為 Deferred / problem-triggered，不阻擋結案。
flow: Operational: Human/Conversation artifact → Primary local processing → Dropbox staging → [COLLAB] Artifact Batch Publish → GitHub; GitHub text/source → Primary processing/rendering → Dropbox /AI Output → iOS Files/Preview. /AI 工作區 is Primary autonomous scratch/staging with verified cleanup lifecycle. Dropbox PDF reading: <=5 MiB full extracted text; >5 MiB metadata/preview/temp link only, no current page-range primitive.
